decisions.reason: The block-agnostic rule awarding one ticket to a random existing ticket holder remains valid for the continuing Small Block prize system.
The source retains the $10 affiliate allocation and does not change the commission trigger, recipient, timing, destination, or cap.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references and replaces the affected prize copy with Small Block-only content.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block FAQ content, retains the continuing $900 prizes, and records the revised purchase allocation.
The source preserves the $10 affiliate allocation and does not alter the no-referral recipient-selection rule.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket lifecycle and narrows the scope contexts to the remaining Small Block system.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the NFT token serial used as the referral code or any of its display locations.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter visibility attribute while preserving the remaining metadata fields.
The general rule that active prize tickets follow the NFT remains valid for active Small Block tickets and contains no Big Block-specific attribute.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $8 purchase allocation to the continuing prize pool; the Small Block winner and draw rules remain unchanged.
Automatic wallet transfer remains the payout mode for the continuing $900 prizes, and the candidate has no Big Block-specific claim attribute.
The generic landing-page reference to prize-draw tickets remains accurate for the continuing Small Block prize draw and does not mention Big Blocks.
